connector.name: QueryPilot
connector.registryDescription: Safe SQL gateway for AI agents: SELECT-only validation, access policies, masking, audit trail, evals
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package querypilot. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nickklos10 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: QUERYPILOT_DATABASE_URL
env.description: SQLAlchemy-style database connection URL, e.g. sqlite:///demo.db or postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db. Equivalent to --database-url.

env.name: QUERYPILOT_DIALECT
env.description: SQL dialect for the connector. Equivalent to --dialect.

env.name: QUERYPILOT_MAX_ROWS
env.description: Maximum rows returned per query. Equivalent to --max-rows.

env.name: QUERYPILOT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env.description: Query execution timeout in seconds. Equivalent to --timeout-seconds.

env.name: QUERYPILOT_ACCESS_POLICY_JSON
env.description: JSON-encoded AccessPolicy (blocked_columns, allowed_columns, row_filters, masking_rules) enforced before execution. Equivalent to --access-policy-json.

env.name: QUERYPILOT_MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP transport used by `querypilot mcp`. Equivalent to --transport. Most MCP clients should leave this at stdio; streamable-http is for clients that speak Streamable HTTP directly.
